title: Pinecone / Milvus — What it is
description: When embeddings grow to millions, Pinecone and Milvus take over: Pinecone is the serverless managed vector database (create an index, upsert (id, vector, metadata) tuples, query by vector) that scales without ops; Milvus (LF AI & Data, built by Zilliz) is the open-source distributed vector DB with collections, partitions, HNSW/IVF indexes and the pymilvus client plus Attu GUI. Both organize embedding space for production RAG. It is made by Pinecone / Zilliz (LF AI & Data) and runs on Cloud + self-hosted (Python clients).
